title: What creates a total solar eclipse? - Andy Cohen
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】是什麼造成了日全食？ ——安迪·科恩（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: On August 21, 2017 the shadow of the Moon will pass from the west coast to the east coast of the U.S.
cues.en: On August 21, 2017 the shadow of the Moon will pass from the west coast to the east coast of the U.S.
cues.zh: 2017 年 8 月 21 日 月亮的陰影會橫掃美國 從西岸到東岸

cues.text: Our blue sky will turn black as night and fill with stars, and there will be a hole in the sky
cues.en: Our blue sky will turn black as night and fill with stars, and there will be a hole in the sky
cues.zh: 我們的藍天會變得像晚上一樣黑 還會有滿天星斗 同時天空中也會出現一個洞

cues.text: where the Sun used to be, surrounded by the fiery ring of the Sun's corona,
cues.en: where the Sun used to be, surrounded by the fiery ring of the Sun's corona,
cues.zh: 就是太陽之前的位置 會被日冕形成的火環所圍繞

cues.text: a total eclipse of the Sun.
cues.en: a total eclipse of the Sun.
cues.zh: 這就是日全食

cues.text: This will truly be a historic event.
cues.en: This will truly be a historic event.
cues.zh: 這就是日全食 這將會是一個歷史性事件 關於日食的紀錄

cues.text: Accounts of solar eclipses date way back on the written record.
cues.en: Accounts of solar eclipses date way back on the written record.
cues.zh: 關於日食的紀錄 可以追溯回古時史書

cues.text: The early Mesopotamians wrote that the Sun was put to shame during the solar eclipse of the 14th century B.C.E.
cues.en: The early Mesopotamians wrote that the Sun was put to shame during the solar eclipse of the 14th century B.C.E.
cues.zh: 可以追溯回古時史書 早期的美索不達米亞人寫道： 太陽蒙羞了 西元前第十四世紀的一場日食

cues.text: and it may have started the Sun worship of the Egyptian pharaoh Akhenaten.
cues.en: and it may have started the Sun worship of the Egyptian pharaoh Akhenaten.
cues.zh: 西元前第十四世紀的一場日食 可能是導致 埃及法老阿肯那頓太陽膜拜的開端

cues.text: Ancient Chinese astrologers paid with their lives if they failed to predict the solar eclipse
cues.en: Ancient Chinese astrologers paid with their lives if they failed to predict the solar eclipse
cues.zh: 古代的中國占星術士如果漏報了日食 或無法預示皇帝的命兆 是要賠上性命的

cues.text: and portend the fate of their emperors whose symbol was the Sun.
cues.en: and portend the fate of their emperors whose symbol was the Sun.
cues.zh: 是要賠上性命的 因為太陽就是皇帝的象徵

cues.text: The earliest date of a specific event in human history, a battle between the armies of Lydia and Media,
cues.en: The earliest date of a specific event in human history, a battle between the armies of Lydia and Media,
cues.zh: 因為太陽就是皇帝的象徵 人類史上最早記載日期的特定事件 為利底亞與米底亞之間的戰爭 發生於西元前 535 年 5 月 28 日

cues.text: occurred on May 28, 535 B.C.E.
cues.en: occurred on May 28, 535 B.C.E.
cues.zh: 發生於西元前 535 年 5 月 28 日

cues.text: when a solar eclipse caused the soldiers to lay down their arms and declare a truce.
cues.en: when a solar eclipse caused the soldiers to lay down their arms and declare a truce.
cues.zh: 發生於西元前 535 年 5 月 28 日 當時發生的日食造成 士兵棄械並宣告停戰

cues.text: So how does it happen?
cues.en: So how does it happen?
cues.zh: 那日食是怎麼形成的？

cues.text: During a total solar eclipse, the Moon moves between the Earth and the Sun.
cues.en: During a total solar eclipse, the Moon moves between the Earth and the Sun.
cues.zh: 當日全食發生時 月球執行到地球與太陽之間

cues.text: When this happens, the disc of the Moon appears to perfectly cover the disc of the Sun
cues.en: When this happens, the disc of the Moon appears to perfectly cover the disc of the Sun
cues.zh: 而且月球的盤面 看起來完全擋住太陽

cues.text: even though the Sun is much larger than the Moon.
cues.en: even though the Sun is much larger than the Moon.
cues.zh: 看起來完全擋住太陽 即使太陽比月球大很多

cues.text: But how is this possible?
cues.en: But how is this possible?
cues.zh: 但這怎麼可能？

cues.text: The Sun is 400 times bigger than the Moon, but by sheer coincidence, the Moon is 390 times closer to Earth.
cues.en: The Sun is 400 times bigger than the Moon, but by sheer coincidence, the Moon is 390 times closer to Earth.
cues.zh: 太陽比月球大了 400 倍 但是就有這麼巧 月球到地球的距離 比日地距離近 390 倍

cues.text: Size and distance cancel each other out so that the Moon and Sun appear to be almost the exactly same size.
cues.en: Size and distance cancel each other out so that the Moon and Sun appear to be almost the exactly same size.
cues.zh: 尺寸及距離的效應互相抵銷 因此月球與太陽看起來 大小幾乎相同

cues.text: Every time the Moon orbits the Earth, once every 27.3 days,
cues.en: Every time the Moon orbits the Earth, once every 27.3 days,
cues.zh: 大小幾乎相同 每次月球繞地球公轉 一圈 27.3 天

cues.text: it has to pass between the Earth and the Sun, a stage called the new moon phase.
cues.en: it has to pass between the Earth and the Sun, a stage called the new moon phase.
cues.zh: 它總會穿過地球與太陽之間一次 這時期稱做新月

cues.text: And every time it passes, the New Moon has a chance to block out the Sun.
cues.en: And every time it passes, the New Moon has a chance to block out the Sun.
cues.zh: 每次它穿過 新月就有機會擋住太陽

cues.text: Most of the time, the Moon passes a little above or a little below the Sun,
cues.en: Most of the time, the Moon passes a little above or a little below the Sun,
cues.zh: 大部分的時間 月球穿過的位置 可能比太陽高一點或低一點

cues.text: but if they align perfectly, the shadow of the Moon will make a narrow path across Earth
cues.en: but if they align perfectly, the shadow of the Moon will make a narrow path across Earth
cues.zh: 但如果它們完全對齊 月球的陰影 就會在地球上掃出一條狹長的食帶

cues.text: and those in the shadows will see a total solar eclipse.
cues.en: and those in the shadows will see a total solar eclipse.
cues.zh: 只有在食帶中的人才能看到日全食

cues.text: Just like on night side of the Earth, the sky during a total eclipse is black
cues.en: Just like on night side of the Earth, the sky during a total eclipse is black
cues.zh: 就像地球在夜晚那側一般 天空在日全食期間是黑暗的

cues.text: and filled with stars.
cues.en: and filled with stars.
cues.zh: 並可見滿天星斗

cues.text: But while the moon perfectly covers the surface of the Sun, it doesn't block out the Sun's outer atmosphere,
cues.en: But while the moon perfectly covers the surface of the Sun, it doesn't block out the Sun's outer atmosphere,
cues.zh: 並可見滿天星斗 但是就算月球完全遮蓋 太陽的表面 它也擋不住太陽的大氣層

cues.text: its corona, which appears as a fiery ring around the dark disc of the moon.
cues.en: its corona, which appears as a fiery ring around the dark disc of the moon.
cues.zh: 即日冕，看起來就像一圈火環 在月球暗影的外圍

cues.text: Solar eclipses occur several times a year, but most often they are partial eclipses
cues.en: Solar eclipses occur several times a year, but most often they are partial eclipses
cues.zh: 一年會發生好幾次日食 但多數情況是日偏食

cues.text: where the Moon doesn't quite line up with the Sun.
cues.en: where the Moon doesn't quite line up with the Sun.
cues.zh: 也就是月球與太陽並非完全對齊

cues.text: And, when the Moon and Sun are perfectly aligned, the Moon is usually too far from Earth in its orbit
cues.en: And, when the Moon and Sun are perfectly aligned, the Moon is usually too far from Earth in its orbit
cues.zh: 再者，有時月球與太陽排成一直線時 月球在公轉軌道上的位置 離地球太遠

cues.text: to completely cover the Sun, creating an annular eclipse.
cues.en: to completely cover the Sun, creating an annular eclipse.
cues.zh: 月球在公轉軌道上的位置 離地球太遠 無法完全遮蓋太陽 就會發生日環食

cues.text: During an annular or partial eclipse, the sky remains bright.
cues.en: During an annular or partial eclipse, the sky remains bright.
cues.zh: 就會發生日環食 在日環食或日偏食發生時 天空依然明亮

cues.text: Even on those rare occasions of a total eclipse, the Moon's shadow is most likely to fall
cues.en: Even on those rare occasions of a total eclipse, the Moon's shadow is most likely to fall
cues.zh: 天空依然明亮 即使是很罕見的日全食 月球的陰影最有可能落在 佔地球 70% 的海面上

cues.text: on the 70% of Earth that is covered by water, and few people, if any, will see it.
cues.en: on the 70% of Earth that is covered by water, and few people, if any, will see it.
cues.zh: 佔地球 70% 的海面上 所以只有極少數人有幸能見到此奇景

cues.text: The eclipse of 2017 will be remarkable on a larger scale because the Moon is slowly moving away from Earth.
cues.en: The eclipse of 2017 will be remarkable on a larger scale because the Moon is slowly moving away from Earth.
cues.zh: 所以只有極少數人有幸能見到此奇景 2017 年的日食很值得注意， 因為長久來看 月球正逐漸遠離地球

cues.text: If a furry ancestor of ours had bothered to look up during a solar eclipse a hundred million years ago,
cues.en: If a furry ancestor of ours had bothered to look up during a solar eclipse a hundred million years ago,
cues.zh: 月球正逐漸遠離地球 如果我們有著毛皮的祖先願意費神 在幾億年前的一場日食中抬頭仰望

cues.text: it wouldn't have seen the fiery corona of the Sun.
cues.en: it wouldn't have seen the fiery corona of the Sun.
cues.zh: 在幾億年前的一場日食中抬頭仰望 他不會看到太陽的日冕火環

cues.text: It would have just been dark.
cues.en: It would have just been dark.
cues.zh: 只有一片漆黑

cues.text: Eventually, the Moon will have moved too far from Earth to completely cover the disc of the Sun.
cues.en: Eventually, the Moon will have moved too far from Earth to completely cover the disc of the Sun.
cues.zh: 只有一片漆黑 總有一天，月球會因離地球太遠 再也無法完全遮蔽太陽

cues.text: It is only during our little wink of Earth's history that the Moon is at just the right distance
cues.en: It is only during our little wink of Earth's history that the Moon is at just the right distance
cues.zh: 再也無法完全遮蔽太陽 只有在地球歷史上這段 轉瞬般短暫的時間內 月球位在恰好的距離 能造成日全食

cues.text: to cause a total solar eclipse yet not block the Sun's corona.
cues.en: to cause a total solar eclipse yet not block the Sun's corona.
cues.zh: 能造成日全食 卻不會擋住日冕

cues.text: So on August 21, 2017, when the Moon exactly lines up with the Sun
cues.en: So on August 21, 2017, when the Moon exactly lines up with the Sun
cues.zh: 所以在 2017 年 8 月 21 日 當月球與太陽恰恰形成一直線 而且月球與地球的距離夠近

cues.text: and the Moon is close enough to the Earth, its shadow will cross the U.S.
cues.en: and the Moon is close enough to the Earth, its shadow will cross the U.S.
cues.zh: 而且月球與地球的距離夠近 它的暗影才會橫掃美國

cues.text: and, if you happen to be in its narrow path, you will witness one of the most awe-inspiring sights in the universe.
cues.en: and, if you happen to be in its narrow path, you will witness one of the most awe-inspiring sights in the universe.
cues.zh: 它的暗影才會橫掃美國 如果你剛好位在月影的狹長食帶上 你將會見證一場 宇宙間最令人敬畏的景象

cues.text: But, as incredible as this event will be, total eclipses are one of the most dangerous as well.
cues.en: But, as incredible as this event will be, total eclipses are one of the most dangerous as well.
cues.zh: 宇宙間最令人敬畏的景象 但是，就像這起事件非常奇妙 日全食也非常危險 只有專為觀察太陽而設計的

cues.text: Only specially tinted filters, specifically designed to observe the Sun, should be used.
cues.en: Only specially tinted filters, specifically designed to observe the Sun, should be used.
cues.zh: 只有專為觀察太陽而設計的 特殊染色濾鏡 能拿來看日食

cues.text: The eclipse might put the Sun to shame, but even a shamed Sun can seriously damage your eyes.
cues.en: The eclipse might put the Sun to shame, but even a shamed Sun can seriously damage your eyes.
cues.zh: 能拿來看日食 日食可能使太陽蒙羞了 但是即使是蒙羞的太陽 也能嚴重傷害你的眼睛
